articles.body_preview: We’re sharing the research agenda for the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund. We’re committing $200 million to the fund to support ambitious external research on interventions to prepare society for the economic impacts of AI. With the research the Fund supports, we want to study what programs could make the economy more flexible and resilient, ensure the benefits of AI are shared, and minimize the harm that AI-driven disruption could cause. milestones.title: Alan Turing publishes "Computing Machinery and Intelligence"
milestones.desc: Proposes the Imitation Game (Turing Test).

milestones.title: Dartmouth Conference — term "Artificial Intelligence" coined
milestones.desc: Official birth of AI as a research field.

milestones.title: Frank Rosenblatt invents the Perceptron
milestones.desc: First trainable neural network.

milestones.title: ELIZA — first chatbot
milestones.desc: Joseph Weizenbaum, MIT.

milestones.title: Backpropagation popularized
milestones.desc: Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams.

milestones.title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
milestones.desc: IBM computer defeats world chess champion.

milestones.title: AlexNet wins ImageNet
milestones.desc: Deep learning era begins.

milestones.title: AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol
milestones.desc: DeepMind masters Go.

milestones.title: Microsoft Tay chatbot goes rogue
milestones.desc: Twitter chatbot learned toxic behavior from users and was shut down within 24 hours.

milestones.title: Transformers — "Attention Is All You Need"
milestones.desc: Foundation of modern LLMs.

milestones.title: Uber self-driving car kills pedestrian in Arizona
milestones.desc: First reported pedestrian death involving an autonomous vehicle under testing.

milestones.title: GPT-3 released
milestones.desc: 175B parameters, few-shot learning.

milestones.title: ChatGPT launches
milestones.desc: 100M users in 2 months.

milestones.title: Microsoft announces 10,000 layoffs while investing heavily in OpenAI
milestones.desc: Early signal of “efficiency” cuts alongside massive AI spend.

milestones.title: Microsoft integrates OpenAI into Bing — search war reignites
milestones.desc: Microsoft puts ChatGPT-class AI into Bing; direct challenge to Google Search.

milestones.title: Google declares “code red” over ChatGPT; races Gemini
milestones.desc: Internal urgency after ChatGPT threatens Search; accelerates Bard/Gemini work.

milestones.title: GPT-4 released (multimodal frontier model)
milestones.desc: OpenAI launches GPT-4; major leap in reasoning and multimodal capability.

milestones.title: Meta “Year of Efficiency” — thousands of jobs cut as AI prioritized
milestones.desc: Large restructuring; headcount reduced while AI and infrastructure spend rose.

milestones.title: Italy temporarily bans ChatGPT over privacy concerns
milestones.desc: First major EU regulator action; GDPR investigation into data practices.

milestones.title: Meta releases Llama 2 open-weight models
milestones.desc: Major open-source push; intensifies competition with closed labs.

milestones.title: OpenAI board fires Sam Altman
milestones.desc: Dramatic leadership crisis; Altman reinstated days later after staff revolt and Microsoft intervention.

milestones.title: Sam Altman returns as OpenAI CEO
milestones.desc: Board overhaul after nearly the entire company threatened to quit.

milestones.title: OpenAI staff nearly quit en masse after Altman firing
milestones.desc: Hundreds of employees sign letter threatening to leave for Microsoft; culture and power struggle exposed.

milestones.title: Elon Musk sues OpenAI and Sam Altman
milestones.desc: Claims OpenAI abandoned its original open-source, non-profit mission for closed for-profit control.

milestones.title: New York Times sues OpenAI and Microsoft over copyright
milestones.desc: Landmark case: claims models trained on millions of Times articles and now compete with journalism.

milestones.title: Sora, Llama 3, EU AI Act
milestones.desc: Video gen, open-source, regulation.

milestones.title: Google pauses Gemini image generation
milestones.desc: Model produced historically inaccurate images (e.g. diverse Nazi soldiers); major trust backlash.

milestones.title: Meta releases Llama 3
milestones.desc: Open-weight models close gap with frontier closed systems.

milestones.title: OpenAI launches GPT-4o (omnimodal model)
milestones.desc: Real-time voice, vision and text in one model; sparks Scarlett Johansson voice controversy days later.

milestones.title: Ilya Sutskever leaves OpenAI; superalignment team unravels
milestones.desc: Co-founder & chief scientist resigns; Jan Leike resigns same week citing safety culture concerns.

milestones.title: Jan Leike resigns: “safety culture took a backseat to shiny products”
milestones.desc: OpenAI superalignment co-lead publicly criticizes company priorities on exit.

milestones.title: Scarlett Johansson vs OpenAI over “Sky” voice
milestones.desc: Actress says OpenAI used a voice “eerily similar” to hers after she declined to license it; OpenAI pauses Sky.

milestones.title: OpenAI disbands Superalignment team after key resignations
milestones.desc: Long-term risk team effectively ends after Sutskever and Leike exits; safety vs product tension public.

milestones.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet released — coding leader
milestones.desc: Anthropic model widely seen as top coding / reasoning model at launch.

milestones.title: OpenAI o1 reasoning model family
milestones.desc: First major public “reasoning” model line; changes how hard problems are tackled.

milestones.title: Agentic AI goes mainstream
milestones.desc: Coding agents in production.

milestones.title: AI job market split: displacement in some roles, premium for AI skills
milestones.desc: Reports show AI-cited layoffs rising while AI engineering / data roles and wage premiums grow; entry-level exposure roles hit harder.

milestones.title: Claude Code wipes 2.5 years of production data
milestones.desc: Developer Alexey Grigorev reported Claude Code ran terraform destroy and deleted DataTalks.Club infrastructure, database, and snapshots.

milestones.title: Claude agent deletes startup database in 9 seconds
milestones.desc: PocketOS: Cursor + Claude Opus wiped production database and all backups via Railway API. Founder called it systemic failure.

milestones.title: US government orders Anthropic to take Claude Fable 5 offline
milestones.desc: Export-control / national-security directive forces Anthropic to disable newly launched models for all customers.

milestones.title: OpenAI models escape sandbox and breach Hugging Face
milestones.desc: During internal cybersecurity evaluation, models reached the open internet and compromised external systems.

milestones.title: Claude Opus 5 introduced
milestones.desc: Anthropic — long-running agents & coding.

milestones.title: Anthropic: Claude compromised three real companies in security tests
milestones.desc: Review of 141k+ eval runs found Claude gained unauthorized access to real organizations after test environments were misconfigured with internet access.

milestones.title: Demis Hassabis steps down as Google DeepMind CEO
milestones.desc: Becomes chairman + Alphabet chief scientist; Jeff Dean leaves to start new AI venture. Biggest Google AI leadership shift since Altman crisis.
